description: This file defines the ADODB Oracle database driver, including connection management, query execution, and recordset handling specific to Oracle databases.

classes.name: ADODB_oracle
classes.description: This class manages the connection to an Oracle database, including connection, transaction, and error handling operations.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oracle
classes.description: This class manages recordset operations for Oracle queries, including fetching, seeking, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: DBDate
methods.description: Formats a date for Oracle SQL using TO_DATE.

methods.name: DBTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp for Oracle SQL using TO_DATE with specific format.

methods.name: BindDate
methods.description: Converts database date string to PHP date string.

methods.name: BindTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts database timestamp string to PHP date string.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from Oracle operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves the last error code from Oracle operations.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to an Oracle database with provided credentials and parameters.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to an Oracle database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query on the Oracle database.
